description: Block until a request arrives, then return it in full (same shape as get_request). By default it returns the next request not yet returned by wait_for_request for this inbox and these filters, so nothing that arrives between calls is missed, including requests that came in before the first call. Times out after timeout_seconds (default 30, max 300) with timed_out: true; call it again to keep waiting.

after.description: Start after this request id instead of the saved position. "start" includes everything stored; "latest" waits for something new. Explicit positions are not saved.

inbox_key.description: The inbox_key returned by create_inbox (starts with "porch_sk_").

method.description: Only requests with this HTTP method, e.g. "POST".

path_prefix.description: Only requests whose path (after the inbox URL) starts with this, e.g. "/stripe".

name: wait_for_request

cursor.description: The position after this call. Pass as "after" to continue from here explicitly.

approval_choice.description: Set when this request answered an approval link.

body_output_truncated.description: The body shown here was cut to max_body_bytes.

body_truncated.description: The sender's body was larger than the server keeps.

form.description: The body parsed as a form, when it is form-encoded.

id.description: Request id, e.g. "req_3". Use it with get_request or as a cursor ("after").

json.description: The body parsed as JSON, when it is JSON.

path.description: Path after the inbox URL, e.g. "/stripe".

body_base64.description: Exact body bytes. Send these bytes unchanged so signatures still verify.

curl.description: POSIX shell command that sends the exact request. Run it where the target is reachable.

title: Wait for request
